name: Willcox launch: invitation to participate
subjectTemplate: CheckOff just launched in Willcox — we'd love to include your business
firstTouchBody:
Hi {{contact_name}},

CheckOff is launching in Willcox today!

We're partnering with the Willcox Chamber of Commerce to help locals and visitors discover the businesses, experiences, and hidden gems that make this community special.

I'm Jerry, the founder of CheckOff, and I'm in Willcox through Sunday for the Wine Festival. I'll be visiting local businesses throughout the weekend and would love to meet you.

We're continuing to build out Willcox's presence in CheckOff, and I'd love for your business to be part of the conversation.

If you're interested in having your business considered for CheckOff, please connect with the Willcox Chamber of Commerce about membership and participation.

I'm also carrying CheckOff window clings and promotional materials, and you can explore the Willcox kit here:
{{kit_url}}

If we don't meet while I'm visiting businesses, look for me at the Wine Festival!

Hope to see you this weekend,
Jerry Stuckart
Founder, CheckOff
https://getcheckoff.com
